title: Roll out blob metadata without losing live updates
prompt:
Repair `migration.go`, the resumable metadata backfill for a blob store. Keep the existing public API. The rollout owns only two absent-key backfills: copy a blob's non-empty `ContentType` into `content-type`, and its non-empty `Checksum` into `sha256`. Existing metadata keys are authoritative even when their value is empty. Preserve every unrelated key, do not mutate maps returned by the store, and do not issue a write when neither owned key is missing.

Use each listed blob version as an optimistic precondition. On `ErrVersionConflict`, re-read that blob, recompute the backfill from the latest source fields and metadata, and retry without overwriting a concurrent writer's values. `maxConflictRetries` is the number of retries allowed after the initial replace attempt. Count every observed conflict, stop after the configured budget, and preserve error identity through wrapping. Non-conflict errors are not retryable.

The durable checkpoint is a page boundary. Load it before listing, return without store work when it is complete, and pass its cursor back to `ListPage` unchanged; cursors are opaque. Process a page completely before saving its next cursor. Never advance the checkpoint after an incomplete page. Save with the loaded checkpoint version. Because a checkpoint save may commit and still return an error, re-read it after any save error and accept the page only if the durable cursor and completion flag exactly equal the attempted state; otherwise return the original error without overwriting newer checkpoint state. A final page, including an empty store, must durably record `Complete=true`.

Keep `Stats` accurate: `Scanned` once per listed entry, `Updated` for each successful metadata replacement, `Unchanged` for each entry requiring no replacement, `Conflicts` for every optimistic blob conflict, and `Pages` only after the corresponding page checkpoint is known durable. On any failure, return the partial stats and a contextual error that still works with `errors.Is`.

Do not modify `model.go`, `fake_store.go`, `go.mod`, `protected_tests/`, or `tests/`. Verification is local, offline, and deterministic. Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py` from the repository root.

full_distill.primary_skill: implement a resumable paginated Go backfill that merges metadata under per-object optimistic concurrency and advances only durable page-boundary checkpoints
full_distill.baseline_evidence: the current migrator ignores its loaded resume cursor, saves each page checkpoint before processing the page, replaces authoritative metadata from stale list snapshots, mutates store-owned maps, performs unnecessary writes, and has no version-conflict recovery or ambiguous-checkpoint reconciliation
full_distill.success_contract: the rollout passes opaque cursors unchanged, backfills only absent owned keys from the latest blob state, preserves concurrent and unrelated metadata, respects the exact conflict retry budget, records accurate partial statistics, and advances a compare-and-set checkpoint only after a complete page or after confirming an ambiguous save committed
adversarial_factors: a restart begins from a non-empty opaque cursor after a failure late in the following page, exposing both start-over and premature-checkpoint implementations

a live writer changes source fields, installs an authoritative owned key, and edits unrelated metadata between list and replace, requiring a re-read and full recomputation after the optimistic conflict
an always-busy blob distinguishes the initial replace from the configured number of conflict retries while checking errors.Is and checkpoint non-advancement
an alias guard retains the exact metadata maps returned by list and get, rejecting fixes that merge in place even when final persisted values look correct
checkpoint probes separately simulate commit-then-error, reject-before-commit, and a foreign compare-and-set winner, requiring outcome reconciliation without overwriting newer state
existing empty owned values, empty source fields, already-current blobs, an empty store, and a completed rerun expose unconditional writes and incomplete terminal markers
